scoring_justification: Checker verifies nucleation outputs by a range check consistent with classical nucleation theory, and recomputes the heat-transfer curve using the paper's model with known physical constants; pointwise and peak-location comparisons.

outputs.description: Critical nucleus radius (meters) and required undercooling (Kelvin) for steam condensation at 100 deg C.
Heat transfer coefficient alpha_m (W/(m^2 K)) as a function of temperature difference Delta_T (K).

output_contract.notes: For nucleation: the checker verifies that the critical radius and undercooling fall within the ranges 1e-10-1e-7 m and 1-10 K. For heat transfer: the checker recomputes alpha_m(Delta_T) and performs pointwise comparison (10% tolerance) and peak-location check (2-4 K).

steps.description: Verify that the critical radius and undercooling fall within the ranges expected from classical nucleation theory (r_crit in 1e-10-1e-7 m, undercooling in 1-10 K), each weighted equally.
Recompute alpha_m(Delta_T) using the paper's model and agent's undercooling from nucleation.csv; compare pointwise (10% tol) and check peak Delta T in 2-4 K.
